parameters.functionScript:
/*
 * ASK ONCE, ON ARRIVAL (TASK-L171 §1). Nothing is wired to this node's Run, so
 * the runtime runs it once when its script loads — which is when the page that
 * places this component mounts. That is the whole trigger: the roster has no
 * parameter, because the backend decides whose people these are from the
 * session (`role:staff` in nodegx.security.json), never from anything a page
 * sends.
 */
Outputs.ask();

metadata.comment: The fixture's Static Data node stood here and emitted its rows on load. A Function with nothing on Run also runs once on load (simplejavascript.ts, NDA-017 §2), so the call happens exactly when the fixture used to arrive, and no page changes.
Demo stand-in for the backend (TASK-L180). The fixture is backend/fixtures/roster.json in the template.

nodes.label: Ask again — after a coach adds somebody

metadata.comment: TASK-L184: the roster asks once when it mounts (ro_ask). A coach who has just added a learner on this page asks again through this signal, so the new row appears without a reload. Still no parameter: whose people these are is the session's, never the page's.
